modules.module_title: Plan and prepare for the work

pcs.pc_description: Identify work requirements through work orders or as instructed by Supervisor
Identify and apply OISD standards, Occupational Health and Safety standards, Industry’s codes of practice and specifications, environmental requirements throughout the work procedure.
Identify, obtain and inspect resources required to meet the job specifications for compliance.
select and interpret relevant plans, drawings and text in accordance with the work plan.
check the correct size, type and quantity of materials/components for compliance with the job specifications.
coordinate for planning of work in detail, including sequencing, prioritizing and considering plant security and capacity in accordance with site requirements.
identify potential hazards, select prevention/control measures in accordance with the work plan and site procedures.
prepare the work area according to work requirements and site procedures.
check the expected loading on the scaffold/equipment and supporting structure by using load tables and calculations in line with the work plan- Identify any limitations.
Set up the foundations for the scaffold/equipment in accordance with both OISD standards and the established work plan.
Inspect the scaffold/equipment and its components before use for safety and compliance with job and statutory requirements.
Erect safety nets and static lines as needed, in accordance with OISD standards.
Carry out alterations and repairs to the scaffold/equipment, considering critical safety and structural areas, in accordance with job requirements and scaffolding principles.
Check and confirm the stability of the scaffold/equipment through inspections following the work plan.
Complete the inspection log as per requirements
Conduct the inspection of the scaffolding/equipment for damage, corrosion, or wear before dismantling, following statutory requirements and the work plan.
Perform dismantling of the scaffolding/equipment, considering critical structure and safety areas, in accordance with the work plan.
Complete the work and notify the appropriate personnel as per site requirements
Clear the work area of waste, clean it, restore any disturbed areas and secure it following site procedures.
Maintain and store plant, tools and equipment according to site procedures.
Finalize the details of work completion following site procedures and submit to supervisor
